g.text: \"description\": \"A percent in [0, 100]. The whole range is usable, sub-1 values included \\u2014 the unit is in the field n
ame, so nothing is ambiguous. Note that the GitHub Checks gate rounds the measured rate to an integer before comparing (to stay in
step with the eval UI), so a floor below 0.5 behaves there as if it were 0.5; the platform's own verdict compares unrounded.\"\n
\n \"deprecated\": true,\n \"description\": \"Deprecated alias for `minimumPassRatePercent`, same unit. A value
in (0, 1) is REJECTED here \\u2014 it reads as a fraction sent by mistake \\u2014 which is what the `not` below expresses. Use `mi

nimumPassRatePercent` for a genuine sub-1% floor.",
